title: fix(ui): keep cloud startup prompts and progress in chat
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes the initial prompt disappearing while a cloud session starts, and provisioning progress appearing beneath the composer instead of in the conversation.

## User Impact

The submitted prompt remains visible while the worker provisions. Opening a session that is already provisioning also shows progress in the conversation. Sending, retry, and recovery behavior stay unchanged.

## Why This Change Was Made

Share the initial-turn presentation between the eager startup owner and its lazy runtime, preserving attachment identities across the handoff. Feed worker setup into the existing transcript progress indicator. Keep attachment restoration in a small shared module so immediate presentation does not pull the attachment-send implementation into startup.

## Evidence

- Final-head [CI run 35391403103](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/35391403103) is green: 119 successful jobs, 11 intentional skips, including all UI/browser shards, real-Gateway tests, Windows lanes, and the unchanged bundle-size gate.

- 166 focused unit tests and 18 production-bundle browser scenarios passed, covering startup, failure, reconnect, retry, and navigation during provisioning. The final startup-owner rerun passed all 24 cases.
- UI and test typechecks, targeted lint and style checks, formatting, structural guards, and unused-export checks passed.
- Independent review found no actionable issues.
- The initial hosted run was blocked by a stale quota-test expectation on main. The correction landed upstream in #152010; this PR is rebased onto it without retaining a duplicate local correction. The same correction was independently verified against all three quota recovery cases locally.
- A second hosted run exposed seven pre-existing UI suite collection failures from a backend fixture import. That repair landed separately in #152099; the final branch includes it through main. The cloud-startup patch is unchanged by both rebases, verified with `git range-diff`.
- The final import-boundary cleanup passes 68 focused tests, four production-bundle browser scenarios, UI typechecking, lint, and fresh independent review. The production startup bundle measures 362,147 gzip bytes against the unchanged 363,282-byte limit.
- The attachment adapter now uses the existing object-record conversion helper, and its obsolete assertion exemption is removed. The assertion-safety and coercion-helper guards pass.
- Includes the existing repair commit from #152133 as a dependency: remove three duplicate `promisify` declarations introduced by overlapping main changes. All assertions stay intact. The owning TypeScript graph, existing promisified-process regression, and fresh independent review pass.
- Compatibility: no persisted config/session schema, recovery record format, storage key, or Gateway RPC changes. Saved-turn retry, interrupted-creation recovery, reconnect, and unconfirmed-delivery scenarios passed. Prepared display attachments are derived in memory only; restored recovery records still use the existing validation path.
- Screenshots use synthetic data and a mocked Gateway; no live deployment was changed.

![Before: empty conversation with provisioning beneath the composer](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/cc303ece-c8df-49f4-810f-e20466d51570)

After opening the same provisioning session:

![After: provisioning appears in the conversation](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b24422c0-50be-491a-9271-775b93d4414e)

The initial prompt is also visible before the startup runtime finishes loading:

![Submitted prompt remains visible above provisioning progress](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/04a86511-1a8b-47b6-8dff-58d49ab3ec09)
